description: Tracé géolocalisé des voies de chemin de fer - Geografische voorstelling van de sporen - List and geographical position of the railwaytracks is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Infrabel. Four datasets give: The List and geographical position of the main tracks with a line number on the Infrabel network (e.g. L161). The Geographical position of all track segments: route of all track segments on the Infrabel network, not only the main tracks. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 4 resources in JSON. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
